features.name: terraced combat arena
features.notes: Stepped or terraced relief with strong elevation and no overhangs
features.quote: Terraced Arena: Stepped or terraced relief — strong elevation, nothing overhanging.

features.name: central fighting platform
features.quote: A large flat central fighting platform

features.name: raised side platforms
features.notes: At different heights around the central platform
features.quote: Raised side platforms at different heights for vertical combat

features.name: connecting stairs and ramps
features.notes: Connecting central platform to raised side platforms at each height
features.quote: stairs and ramps connecting the flat central platform to the raised side platforms at each height

features.name: perimeter boundary wall
features.notes: Solid wall running the full perimeter, tall enough to contain the fighting space
features.quote: a solid boundary wall running the full perimeter of the arena, tall enough to keep fighters inside the fighting space.

features.name: scattered low cover walls
features.quote: Low walls and cover obstacles scattered around for tactical positioning

features.name: scattered cover pillars
features.notes: Pillars and columns across the arena floor alongside low walls
features.quote: Pillars and columns scattered across the arena floor alongside low walls, giving tactical cover and breaking line of sight

features.name: mixed material surfaces
features.quote: Make it look sturdy and game-ready with a mix of materials.

features.name: primary colored structures
features.notes: Main color applied to arena floor and structures
features.quote: PrimaryColor (main color of the arena floor and structures)

features.name: accent colored details
features.notes: Accent color applied to pillars, accents, and details
features.quote: AccentColor (color for pillars, accents, and details)

excluded.name: configurable attributes
excluded.why: authoring parameters rather than fixed visible choices
